The '''Mort Myre Swamp''', once a forest known as '''Humblethorn''',{{CiteNPC|npc=Drezel|loc=Nature Spirit|quote=Mort Myre was once a beautiful forest by the name of Humblethorn until the evil denizens of Morytania descended.}} is a swampland in western [[Morytania]]. Players first unlock the gate to the swampland by starting [[Nature Spirit]], but the swamp can also be accessed by [[Barrows teleport|Barrows]] or [[Mort'ton teleport]] scrolls. Much of the swamp is plagued by [[ghast]]s, which attack players and [[Rotten food|rot food]], as well as a [[swamp decay]] effect, hitting the player periodically. Both can be avoided by building a [[Fire of Dehumidification]] after completion of [[Making Friends with My Arm]].

==Layout==
The swamp is divided into the main area, and [[the Hollows]] to the east. The path to [[Mort'ton]] is found to the south, on a bridge just south of the [[Nature Grotto]].

=== Main area ===
The main part of the swamp is accessed by a gate west of [[Canifis]], guarded by [[Ulizius]], which is first opened during the [[Nature Spirit]] quest. In the far south-east is a bridge, leading to the southern part of the swamp. The eastern part of the swamp, [[the Hollows]], can be accessed by a small break in the swamp weed just to the west of the boat (marked by a transportation symbol [[File:Transportation icon.png]] on the map). In this area, players can also find:

*[[Nature Grotto]] - In the south-west of this part of the swamp is a [[Nature Altar]], used during the [[Nature Spirit]] quest. Here, players can bless their [[silver sickle]] to make a [[silver sickle (b)]] and recharge their [[Prayer points]]. [[Filliman Tarlock]] is also found here.
*[[Fairy ring|Fairy rings]]:
**Code {{fairycode|ALQ}} for the ring in the Haunted Woods
**Code {{fairycode|CKS}} for the ring just north of the gate to the swamp near Canifis
**Code {{fairycode|BKR}} for the ring in the swamp south-east of the gate. 
**After the [[In Search of the Myreque]] quest, code {{fairycode|DLS}} can be used to access the [[Myreque Hideout]] which has an exit in the swamp at the Hollows and another behind the [[Hair of the Dog]] tavern in Canifis.
**Code {{fairycode|BIP}} leads to an island near the [[Nature Grotto]].
*The [[Fire of Dehumidification]], removing swamp decay and the rotting of food via ghasts after being built.
*Several [[swamp tar]] spawns.
*[[Slimy eel]]s are available at five [[Fishing spots]] in the area.
*Several pieces of dead vegetation, which players can use with the aid of a [[silver sickle (b)|blessed silver sickle]] to fill a [[druid pouch]] to protect them from the [[ghast]]s. As well as filling a druid pouch, these [[Mort myre fungi|Mort Myre fungi]] are used in [[Herblore]].
Directly south of the swamp is a long, winding path leading to [[Mort'ton]]. There are no [[ghast]]s here, but plenty of [[snail]]s. Players will also find [[Zealot]] at the very south of this section, at the entrance to the [[Abandoned Mine]]. It is here that players can start the [[Haunted Mine]] quest.

=== The Hollows ===
{{main|The Hollows}}
The eastern part of the swamp is itself cut in half, and is known as the Hollows. Players can only cross from the main area into here via a rope bridge, which they mend during the [[In Search of the Myreque]] quest. Here, players can find:

*The [[Myreque Hideout]], guarded by [[Curpile Fyod]]. It contains a tunnel leading to a trapdoor south of the [[Hair of the Dog]] pub in [[Canifis]], and it can only be accessed for further use after the quest is complete. The hideout provides a quicker way to [[Mort'ton]] than walking through the main and southern parts of the swamp, and is also safer, as players will encounter significantly fewer [[ghast]]s.
*A [[Hunter]] area where players can catch [[swamp lizards]].
*[[Swamp Boaty|Swamp boaty]] - [[Cyreg Paddlehorn]]'s swamp boaty, unlocked after the [[Nature Spirit]] quest, can be taken to Mort'ton.
*A mysterious graveyard lies just north of [[Castle Drakan]], known as the [[Morytania Graveyard]]. This is where [[Dessous]] resides during the [[Desert Treasure I]] quest.

==Navigation==
[[File:Barrows Map.png|310px|thumb|Navigate the swamp using any of the coloured routes.]]
Directly on the right, there is a map that might be useful for navigation through the confusing swamp of [[Morytania]]. It can be used to get to or back from [[Canifis]], [[Mort'ton]], [[Burgh de Rott]], [[Barrows]], etc.

Several routes to [[Barrows]] have been drawn:

*The '''Red''' direct teleport option [[Barrows Teleport]] ([[Barrows teleport (tablet)|tab]]) from the [[Arceuus spellbook]] is the fastest.
*The '''Dark Blue''' path is the next shortest route making use of the [[Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport]]. This option only works once every 30 minutes, and requires completion of [[Shades of Mort'ton]].
*The '''Green''' path is next, requiring the use of [[Mort'ton teleport]] scrolls, received as a reward from clue scrolls. 
*The '''Orange''' path requires the completion of the [[Morytania Hard Diary|Morytania Hard]] or [[Morytania Elite Diary]]. Using the [[Morytania legs 3]] or [[Morytania legs 4|4]] received as a reward, you can teleport directly to Burgh de Rott. 
*The '''Light Blue''' path is the moderate route that goes directly to the [[Hollows]] and the [[Swamp Boaty]] without using the Canifis [[Myreque Hideout]] route. As it makes use of fairy rings and the swamp boat, it requires starting [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] and completion of [[Nature Spirit]].
*The '''Pink''' path is one of the longest routes and makes use of the [[Myreque shortcut|Myreque Hideout underground tunnel]], requiring near full completion of [[In Search of the Myreque]]. The entry point of the hideout tunnel-network is located at the back of [[Hair of the Dog|the inn in Canifis]]. 
*The '''Yellow''' path is a tedious route, but skips past '''most''' of the Ghasts. Occasionally a ghast will wander in range of the fairy ring, though. Also required starting [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]].
*The most tedious route that leads through the swamp itself is via walking. This will take the longest, and players will suffer more [[ghast]] attacks, but one does not need to complete any quest besides [[Priest in Peril]] to use this path. There are multiple paths, all starting at the gate in the left top, eventually following the same route as yellow past the bridge in the left bottom.
Additionally, not drawn here, one can use the [[Temple Trekking]] [[Minigames|Minigame]] to get from Burgh de Rott to Paterdomus quickly, after [[In Aid of the Myreque]]. Inversely, after [[Darkness of Hallowvale]], [[Burgh de Rott Ramble]] can be used to get from Paterdomus to Burgh de Rott quickly. Simply assist an easy companion over an easy route. 

==Dangers==
Entering the swamp subjects players to [[swamp decay]], an [[Area effects|area effect]] that hits them for between one and three [[damage]]. This damage '''can''' kill players. Equipping a [[Silver sickle (b)|blessed silver sickle]], [[Rod of Ivandis]], [[Ivandis flail]] or [[Blisterwood flail]] (or simply having them in the inventory), will prevent the decay timer from starting. Alternatively, after [[Making Friends with My Arm]], players can build the [[fire of dehumidification]], which nullifies swamp decay and the food rotting effect of [[ghast]]s.

Several monsters also reside in the swamp:

==Trivia==
* If a player attempts to open the gate without starting Nature Spirit, they will notice a message on the gate saying {{Mes|Mort Myre is a dangerous Ghast infested swamp. Do not enter if you value your life. All persons wishing to enter must see Drezel.}}

* If a player exits Mort Myre through the gate to [[Canifis]], [[Ulizius]] exclaims {{Overhead|Oh my! You're still alive!}}
*"[[wiktionary:mort|Mort]]" is a word used in several languages and originating in Latin, meaning dead or death, while "{{wp|mire}}" is a term for wetland terrain such as swamps.
